name: City Council Meeting - Mar 12, 2024
agenda_text:
TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  MARCH 12, 2024
  REGULAR MEETING
  5:00 P.M. - CLOSED SESSION
  6:30 P.M. - REGULAR BUSINESS BEGINS
  IN COUNCIL CHAMBER AT 3031 TORRANCE BL.

  CITY COUNCIL MAY TAKE ACTION ON ANY ITEM LISTED ON THE AGENDA

Revised City Council Agenda 03-12-24

*Denotes the item was added after posting of the agenda.

OPENING CEREMONIES

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

14.  CLOSED SESSION

  14A. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE DISCIPLINE/DISMISSAL/RELEASE (California Government
  Code §54957)
  14A - REVISED STAFF REPORT

  14B. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR (California Government Code
  §54957.6): Agency Negotiator: Aram Chaparyan Employee
  Organization/Association:
  1. Certain Full-Time Salaried and Hourly Employees
  2. Certain Part-Time Hourly Employees
  3. Crossing Guards

  5. Engineers and Torrance Fiscal Employees Association

  10. Fire Safety Management
  11. Torrance Fire Fighters Association

  13. Torrance Municipal Employees/AFSCME Local 1117 AFL-CIO
  14. Torrance Police Commanders Association (TPCA)
  15. Torrance Police Officers Association
  16. Torrance Professional Parks & Recreation Employees Organization
  17. Torrance Professional & Supervisory Association
  18. Torrance Recurrent Recreational Employees Organization
  19. City Treasurer
  20. City Clerk
  21. City Attorney
  22. City Manager

  14C. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE DISCIPLINE/DISMISSAL/RELEASE (California Government
  Code §54957)

  14D. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION (California Government Code
  §54957(b)(1)): Title: City Attorney

  14E. REAL PROPERTY – CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR
   (California Government Code §54956.8):
  1)  Property: Assessor Parcel Numbers 7352-015-005 and 7352-015-900, Torrance, CA
  90503 Agency Negotiator: Aram Chaparyan Negotiating Parties: City of Torrance and
  Prologis, Inc. (Nicol Torstvet) Under Negotiation: Price and terms and conditions of
  lease and easements

*The following item was added on Thursday, March 7, 2024.

  14F. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION
  (California Government Code §54956.9(d)(1)): 1) Claudette Leslie, et al. v. Meridian
  Management Associates, LLC, et al. LASC Case No. 21STCV42993

10B. City Manager – Conduct Closed Hearing on the Appeal of the Civil Service
  Commission Decision Sustaining the Termination of a Police Officer (7). Confidential
  under Penal Code 832.7 and Copley Press v. Superior Court 39 Cal. 4th 1272 (2006).
  Consideration of Public Employee Discipline will be Conducted in Closed Session per
  California Government Code Section 54957(b)(1), unless the Employee Requests to
  Have the Appeal Conducted in Public Session. The Deliberation of this Matter by the
  City Council will occur in Closed Session. Expenditure: None.
  10B - STAFF REPORT

RECESSED TO CLOSED SESSION - Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9 (d)(1)

RECONVENED IN PUBLIC SESSION

2.  FLAG SALUTE: Councilmember Kalani

  NON SECTARIAN INVOCATION: Councilmember Lewis

3.  REPORT OF THE CITY CLERK ON THE POSTING OF THE AGENDA The agenda was
  posted on the Public Notice Board at 3031 Torrance Bl. and on the City’s Website on
  Tuesday, March 5, 2024 /s/ Rebecca Poirier
  3 - AFFIDAVIT

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READING OF RESOLUTIONS AND ORDINANCES AFTER
NUMBER & TITLE – See Council Rules of Order Section 2.11 (Resolution 2006-65)

4.  ANNOUNCEMENT OF WITHDRAWN, DEFERRED, AND/OR SUPPLEMENTAL ITEMS

5.  COUNCIL COMMITTEE MEETINGS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

6.  COMMUNITY MATTERS

  6A. Recognition of $10,000 Donation from Torrance Refining Company, LLC for
  Torrance Police Department’s John J. Neu Leadership Academy.

7.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15 minute period) This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comment on items under the Consent Calendar or items that
  are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on
  items raised during public comment, but may respond briefly to statements made or
  questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals
  are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no
  longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If
  presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk
  before speaking.
  PUBLIC COMMENT
  PUBLIC COMMENT RECEIVED AFTER 5:30 P.M. ON 3/11/24 AND BEFORE 1:50 A.M. ON
  3/13/24

8.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one
  vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by
  a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..
   8A. Police – Appropriate Funds and Authorize Change Order #2 to Purchase Order
  for Police Vehicle Outfitting. Expenditure: $4,998.68 (Non-General Fund).
  Recommendation of the Chief of Police that City Council:
  1) Appropriate $4,999.68 from Asset Forfeiture Fund’s fund balance to Facility,
  Equipment, and Automation Plan (FEAP) 1132 – Police Vehicle Outfitting Project; and
  2) Authorize change order #2 to the purchase order with Dana Safety Supply of Canoga
  Park, CA (PO# 2023-00000049) in the amount of $4,998.68, for a new not-to-exceed
  amount of $288,026.29, to provide police vehicle outfitting.
  8A - STAFF REPORT

  8B. City Treasurer – Accept and File Investment Report for the Month of January
  2024. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Treasurer that City Council accept and file the Investment
  Report for the month of January 2024.
  8B - STAFF REPORT

  8C. Community Services – Accept and File Update on City’s Animal Control Program.
  Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council accept and file
  update on the City’s Animal Control Program.
  8C - STAFF REPORT

9.  ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS

  9A. City Manager – Approve Request to Set Closed Hearing Date to Consider
  Employee Termination Appeal. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council approve request to set a date of
  Tuesday, June 18, 2024 to conduct a closed hearing to consider an appeal of the Civil
  Service Commission’s decision sustaining the termination of a Police Officer (6).
  9A - STAFF REPORT

  9B. City Manager - Discuss and Determine Action to Address Request for Subsidy of
  Rental Fees for Use of El Retiro Park by Hollywood Riviera Sportsman’s Club
  (HRSC). Expenditure: $500 (General Fund).
  In response to an oral request by Councilmember Mike Griffiths with City Council
  concurrence, it is the recommendation of the City Manager that City Council discuss and
  determine action to address the request for subsidy in the amount of $500 for use of El
  Retiro Park by the Hollywood Riviera Sportsman's Club (HRSC) for its 48th Annual Easter
  Egg Hunt to be held on March 30, 2024.
  9B - STAFF REPORT
  LATE PUBLIC COMMENT

  9C. Finance and Governmental Operations Committee – Accept and File Annual
  Comprehensive Financial Report for Fiscal Year Ended 2022-23 and Fiscal Year
  2023-24 Mid-Year Budget Review Report, Approve Proposed Program
  Modifications, and Appropriate Funds. Expenditure: $499,528 (General Fund and
  Non-General Fund).
  Recommendation of the Finance and Governmental Operations Committee that City
  Council:
  1) Accept and file the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report for the Fiscal Year Ended
  2022-23; and
  2) Accept and file the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Mid-Year Budget Review Report; and
  3) Approve the proposed program modification in the City Clerk’s fiscal year 2023-24
  General Fund operating budget in the amount of $2,474 per year; and
  4) Approve the proposed program modification in the City Manager’s fiscal year 2023-24
  General Fund operating budget in the amount of $85,427 per year; and
  5) Approve the proposed program modification in the Community Services Department’s
  fiscal year 2023-24 General Fund operating budget in the amount of $54,723 per year;
  and
  6) Approve the proposed program modification in the Finance Department’s fiscal year
  2023-24 General Fund operating budget for a savings of $54,332 per year; and
  7) Approve the proposed program modification in the Finance Department’s fiscal year
  2023-24 Self-Insurance Fund operating budget in the amount of $78,557 per year; and
   8)  Approve the proposed program modification in the General Services Department’s
  fiscal year 2023-24 General Fund operating budget in the amount of $54,339 per year;
  and
  9) Approve the proposed program modification in the Police Department’s fiscal year
  2023-24 General Fund operating budget in the amount of $278,340 per year; and
  10) Increase the Section 8 Housing Fund’s fiscal year 2023-24 operating revenue budget
  by $850,000; and
  11) Appropriate $850,000 to the Section 8 Housing Fund’s fiscal year 2023-24 operating
  expenditure budget.
  9C - STAFF REPORT
  9C - SUPPLEMENTAL

  9D. Transportation Committee – Accept and File Report on Public Safety at Transit
  Stations and Terminals and Provide Direction on Official Position Regarding LA
  Metro C-Line Extension to Torrance. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Transportation Committee that City Council:
  1) Accept and file a report on public safety at transit stations and terminals; and
  2) Provide direction on the City’s official position regarding the LA Metro C-Line Extension
  to Torrance.
  9D - STAFF REPORT
  9D - STAFF PRESENTATION
  LATE PUBLIC COMMENT

  10C. Community Services and Community Development – Conduct Public Hearing on
  Land Use Study 24-00001 Regarding Proposed Amendment to Torrance
  Municipal Code Pertaining to the Approval Process and Placement of Pickleball
  Courts in the P-U (Public Use) Zone, Adopt ORDINANCE Amending Torrance
  Municipal Code, and Adopt California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Exemption. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Community Services Director and Community Development
  Director that City Council:
  1) Conduct a public hearing on Land Use Study 24-00001 regarding proposed
  amendment to Torrance Municipal Code pertaining to the approval process and
  placement of pickleball courts in the P-U (Public Use) Zone; and
  2) Adopt an ORDINANCE amending Torrance Municipal Code Section 91.37.3(a) of
  Chapter 1 of Article 37 of Division 9 Entitled “Land Use”; and
  3) Determine the project is exempt from California Environmental Quality Act pursuant to
  Sections 15378 and 15061(b)(3); and
  4) Approve an Ordinance Summary for publication.
  10C - STAFF REPORT
  10C - SUPPLEMENTAL
  LATE PUBLIC COMMENT

  9E.  City Manager - Discuss and Determine Action to Address Request for Subsidy of
  Landing Fees by Flabob Aviation Associates and Torrance Unified School
  District for S.T.E.M. Day at Torrance Municipal Airport - Zamperini Field.
  Expenditure: Not-to-Exceed $100 (General Fund).
  In response to an oral request by Councilmember Bridgett Lewis with City Council
  concurrence, it is the recommendation of the City Manager that City Council discuss and
  determine action to address the request for subsidy of landing fees for an amount not-to-
  exceed $100 by Flabob Aviation Associates and Torrance Unified School District for a
  Douglas DC-3 aircraft that will participate in a static aircraft exhibit at a S.T.E.M. Day event
  to be held on March 29, I2024.
  9E - STAFF REPORT

RECESS

RECONVENE

9D. Transportation Committee – Accept and File Report on Public Safety at Transit
  Stations and Terminals and Provide Direction on Official Position Regarding LA Metro
  C-Line Extension to Torrance. Expenditure: None.
 10.  HEARINGS

  10A1. Special Counsel - Discuss and Determine Action on Potential City Charter
  Amendments Related to the City Manager, City Attorney, City Clerk, and City
  Treasurer. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Special Counsel that City Council:
  1) Conduct the first public hearing on potential amendments to the City Charter regarding
  the positions of City Manager, City Attorney, City Clerk, and City Treasurer; and
  2) Discuss and determine action on potential amendments to the City Charter; and
  3) Set the date of the second Public Hearing.
  10A1 - STAFF REPORT
  10A-1 STAFF PRESENTATION

  10A2. City Clerk, City Manager, and City Attorney - Conduct First Public Hearing
  on Potential City Charter Amendments. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Clerk, City Manager, and City Attorney that City Council:
  1) Conduct the first public hearing on potential amendments to the City Charter; and
  2) Discuss and determine action on potential amendments to the City Charter; and
  3) Set the date of the second Public Hearing.
  10A2 - STAFF REPORT

  10C. Community Services and Community Development – Conduct Public Hearing on
  Land Use Study 24-00001 Regarding Proposed Amendment to Torrance
  Municipal Code Pertaining to the Approval Process and Placement of Pickleball
  Courts in the P-U (Public Use) Zone, Adopt ORDINANCE Amending Torrance
  Municipal Code, and Adopt California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Exemption. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Community Services Director and Community Development
  Director that City Council:
  1) Conduct a public hearing on Land Use Study 24-00001 regarding proposed
  amendment to Torrance Municipal Code pertaining to the approval process and
  placement of pickleball courts in the P-U (Public Use) Zone; and
  2) Adopt an ORDINANCE amending Torrance Municipal Code Section 91.37.3(a) of
  Chapter 1 of Article 37 of Division 9 Entitled “Land Use”; and
  3) Determine the project is exempt from California Environmental Quality Act pursuant to
  Sections 15378 and 15061(b)(3); and
  4) Approve an Ordinance Summary for publication.
  10C - STAFF REPORT
  10C - SUPPLEMENTAL

11.  AGENCY AGENDAS – None Scheduled.

12.  2ND READING ORDINANCES – None Scheduled.

10C. Community Services and Community Development – Conduct Public Hearing on Land
  Use Study 24-00001 Regarding Proposed Amendment to Torrance Municipal Code
  Pertaining to the Approval Process and Placement of Pickleball Courts in the P-U
  (Public Use) Zone, Adopt ORDINANCE Amending Torrance Municipal Code, and Adopt
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Exemption. Expenditure: None.

RECESS

RECONVENE

10A2. City Clerk, City Manager, and City Attorney - Conduct First Public Hearing on
Potential City Charter Amendments. Expenditure: None.

13.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #2 (Limited up to a 15 minute period) Council Order –
  Lewis, Mattucci, Griffiths, Kaji, Kalani, Mayor Chen This portion of the meeting is
  reserved for comment on items not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act,
  City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment, but may respond
  briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item
  to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral
   Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you
  step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide
  11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking.

RECESSED TO CLOSED SESSION - Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9 (d)(1)

RECONVENED IN PUBLIC SESSION

15.  ADJOURNMENT

  15A. Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, March 26, 2024, at 5:00 p.m. for
  closed session, with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the Leroy J.
  Jackson Council Chamber. Tuesday, March 19, 2024, is a Council Dark Night.
  15A - STAFF REPORT
